H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H4994: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H7101: a magistrate (as deciding) or other leader
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H1497: to pluck off; specifically to flay, strip or rob
H5785: skin (as naked); by implication, hide, leather
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H7607: flesh (as swelling out), as living or forfood; generally food of any kind; figuratively, kindred by blood
H6106: a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pron.) selfsame
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H6584: to spread out (i.e. deploy in hostile array); by analogy, to strip (i.e. unclothe, plunder, flay, etc.)
H5518: a pot; also a thorn (as springing up rapidly); by implication, a hook
H1320: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman
H8432: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
H227: at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore
H2199: to shriek (from anguish or danger); by analogy, (as a herald) to announce or convene publicly
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H5641: to hide (by covering), literally or figuratively
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H6256: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H7489: properly, to spoil (literally, by breaking to pieces); figuratively, to make (or be) good fornothing, i.e. bad (physically, socially or morally)
H3541: properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now
H8582: to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray (literally or figuratively); also causative of both
H5391: to strike with a sting (as a serpent); figuratively, to oppress with interest on a loan
H8127: a tooth (as sharp); specifically ivory; figuratively, a cliff
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H7965: safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H6942: to be (causatively, make, pronounce or observe as) clean (ceremonially or morally)
H4421: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare)
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H3915: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity
H2377: a sight (mentally), i.e. a dream, revelation, or oracle
H2821: to be dark (as withholding light); transitively, to darken
H7080: properly, to distribute, i.e. determine by lot or magical scroll; by implication, to divine
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H8121: the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement
H6937: to be ashy, i.e. darkcolored; by implication, to mourn (in sackcloth or sordid garments)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H954: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed
H2374: a beholder in vision; also a compact (as looked upon with approval)
H2659: to blush; figuratively, to be ashamed, disappointed; causatively, to shame, reproach
H5844: to wrap, i.e. cover, veil, cloth, or roll
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H4390: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
H3581: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H1369: force (literally or figuratively); by implication, valor, victory
H5046: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
H2403: an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender
H6140: to knot or distort; figuratively, to pervert (act or declare perverse)
H6726: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
H1818: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood)
H3389: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
H8199: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
H3548: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
H3384: properly, to flow as water (i.e. to rain); transitively, to lay or throw (especially an arrow, i.e. to shoot); figuratively, to point out (as if by aiming the finger), to teach
H3701: silver (from its pale color); by implication, money
H7130: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
H1558: a circumstance (as rolled around); only used adverbially, on account of
H2790: to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness)
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H3293: a copse of bushes; hence, a forest; hence, honey in the comb (as hived in trees)
